global: A bowl of miso ramen features rich, amber broth cradling tender chashu pork and noodles, topped with finely sliced green onions. Served in a white ceramic bowl, it rests on a dark wooden surface under soft, warm lighting.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, appearing smooth and slightly reflective.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and subtle inner rim discoloration.
regions.soup: The miso broth is amber-brown, glossy, and surrounds thin noodles with green garnish, forming a shallow, circular pool.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is pinkish-brown, tender-looking, thinly sliced, and topped with green onions and white onion rings.
